title: 1578. Minimum Time to Make Rope Colorful

examples.explanation: In the above image, 'a' is blue, 'b' is red, and 'c' is green. Bob can remove the blue balloon at index 2. This takes 3 seconds. There are no longer two consecutive balloons of the same color. Total time = 3.
The rope is already colorful. Bob does not need to remove any balloons from the rope.
Bob will remove the balloons at indices 0 and 4. Each balloons takes 1 second to remove. There are no longer two consecutive balloons of the same color. Total time = 1 + 1 = 2.
